summary: Tier 2 in the Graphite look went from 60 failing (27 Nov) to 23 failing on a whole run made before the last fixes. Every remaining failure then got a program fix or a new-truth test. The later fixes were checked by targeted module runs in Graphite and Day, not by a final whole tier run. The exit -11 crash is fixed: an icon engine made in Python (ux_assets.PackedIcon) was freed while Qt still painted it on a QTabBar. 'This plugin does not support grabbing the keyboard' is only the offscreen platform's harmless warning that every Qt.Popup gives. run_tiers now has the Day and Night looks, always names the look to the child, and takes look lists and --only.

decisions: Every look is passed as GRAPHITE_APPEARANCE. Since D1 an unset variable in a fresh HOME starts in Day, so the window tests of the 27 Nov 'Graphite' run were really run in Day.
Tier 2's default is all four looks; --look both still means Graphite and Kasandra; --look takes lists; --only re-runs chosen units.
hand.door* renamed door.state, door.continue and door.stop. The registry doc was regenerated in the patch; the coordinator regenerates it again at merge.
open_on_work: D2's board opens only on a blank centre.
proposal_profile leaves out the least relevant chosen tools to stay under PLAN_TOOL_LIMIT = 5000.
Day and Night colour pairs are reviewed by the existing words and shapes (SIGNS); no colour was moved.
ui_fit: PlusButton paints a mark and has no words to cut (DRAWS).
findings_for_the_coordinator: W1 owns test_one_name.TheCode's key test, the window sweep's 'Save and Return' finding and name_sweep's code sweep (depths_qt.py lines 390 and 440). These still fail until W1 lands.

In the Kasandra look her column's pane fell from 354 to 317 px (P1) and her words' room from 295 to 259 px. The tests now assert the new numbers, but the owner's 0.8.3 review asked for that room: please check this is wanted. The name-fold assertion in test_kasandra_column is weaker now, because the probe's name no longer fits one line.
Model activation starts LibreOffice's --version (while a tool schema is described).
Day and Night use one green for ready, cue, line and wire, and one red for fails and stopped. Only the words and shapes tell those pairs apart.

release_note: Fixed a crash when a tab with an icon was redrawn. The Settings view is remembered when it was on one of this computer's pages. A trace or doubt no longer replaces your last request on the board. With an empty desk, Graphite opens where you left it. Day and Night are checked for colour-blind readers. The test tiers run in all four looks.
